title: Infant formula, store brand, added rice

content.title: About
content.content: Infant formula with added rice is a ready‑to‑use powdered milk for babies from 6 months onward, enriched with essential vitamins, minerals and easily digestible rice carbohydrates. Produced under a store brand, it meets national and international safety standards for infant nutrition.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Rice in the formula helps smooth digestion and reduces the risk of constipation in infants.
The blend contains DHA and ARA – important fatty acids for brain and eye development.
The product has undergone clinical testing confirming its safety and nutritional adequacy.
Packaging usually includes preparation instructions and age recommendations.
Store brands often provide a more affordable price while maintaining quality.

items.title: Supports growth and development
items.content: Provides the baby with the necessary proteins, fats and carbs to promote normal growth and organ development.

items.title: Contains iron and zinc
items.content: These trace minerals are vital for immune function and cognitive performance.

items.title: B‑vitamin complex
items.content: Helps with energy production and supports the nervous system.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D
items.content: Aid in building strong bone tissue.

items.title: Easily digestible carbohydrate source
items.content: Rice starch provides a steady glucose supply for the infant.

items.title: Cow‑milk protein allergy
items.content: Some infants may react to the bovine milk proteins present in the formula.

items.title: Improper reconstitution
items.content: A solution that is too concentrated can strain the baby’s kidneys.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Prepared formula should be used within 24 hours; otherwise bacterial growth risk increases.

items.title: Storage in hot climates
items.content: High temperatures may degrade nutrient quality.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Mix the powder with warm (not hot) water according to the label instructions, typically 1 tsp per 30 ml of water. Stir until smooth, let it cool to body temperature, and feed the baby immediately.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the bag tightly sealed and use within 24 hours. Discard if you notice off‑odors, discoloration or clumping.
